evidence: Implements Cap'n Proto IPC serialization, updates `libmultiprocess`, and wires `bitcoin-node`, `bitcoin-wallet`, and `bitcoin-gui` process separation.
rationale: This is the category-defining milestone for process separation, implementing Cap'n Proto IPC wrappers and `--enable-multiprocess` to run node, wallet, and GUI in isolated address spaces. It achieves the core architectural goal of privilege separation across components and unblocks subsequent multiprocess integration PRs (#19460, #19461).
